sections.text: I've Never Felt This Feeling Before!?

-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 120% for 120 seconds.
All stats increasing effect boosted by 10% for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Changes Cost held to 30. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Fete Element (increases all stats by 100%, increases cost recovery speed by 10, Ability Power is boosted by 30 when attacking an enemy in Break) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies iron wall for 120 seconds.
Light and Star Defense from Unison Damage +600
